svg.aria-label: In a dark boardroom a gaunt executive is lit from below by a laptop. His red eyes glow, two fangs show in a thin smile, his ears are pointed and an overcoat hangs from his shoulders. Behind him the projector screen glows red and his shadow on it has bat wings. With his little finger raised he holds up a USB stick tagged PIP_Q3_FORECAST_v4. His badge says Dorian V., Strategy, after dark only.
